operator_notes: GitHub-sourced public Vikunja (go-vikunja/vikunja) task object authz modeling package. Faithful model of GET/PUT/DELETE /tasks/{id} using Task.CanRead/CanUpdate/CanDelete which delegate to Project.CanRead/CanWrite (owner or permission). Researcher may use self-hosted Vikunja or static review only. Not a public multi-tenant attack package. No real secrets. Report submission blocked; upstream private security contact via README Security Reports.
